sources.title: lucid-dl · PyPI
sources.snippet: Lucid is a deep learning framework for Apple Silicon, written from scratch. It gives you a familiar Python API on top of a custom C++ engine that talks directly to Apple's hardware stack — MLX on the GPU, Accelerate on the CPU — with no NumPy anywhere in the compute path.

sources.title: Available Models | openai/lucid | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document catalogs all pre-trained models available in Lucid's model zoo, including their variants, specifications, and organizational structure. These models serve as the foundation for neural network interpretability research and visualization tasks.

sources.title: Lucid Is the Model You Use When You Want AI Images to Make Sense
sources.snippet: AI image generation has reached a strange place. Almost every model today can produce something impressive. Sharp details, dramatic lighting, rich colors — the surface quality is rarely the problem anymore. The real issue shows up later.
